reason: Three free months and 59 GEL after that is nothing for my venue, and knowing which tourists and regulars come back, and being able to message them myself, is something I don't have now. I'd switch it on and see if guests actually use the QR.
objection: My waiters will fight it if paying by phone means they lose tips or lose control of the bill, and I don't know yet how big the payment partner's fee per transaction is on top of what my terminal already costs.
would_change_my_mind: If tips can't be added in the QR payment and go straight to the waiter, or if the per-transaction fee turns out higher than my current card terminal, I'd drop it after the free months.
